sections.text: Python, ROS 2, Robotics, Git, Gazebo, OpenCV

Robotics Engineer (Associate), Tarang Automation (Feb 2025 - Aug 2026). Developed ROS 2 nodes for a warehouse mobile robot, implemented the Nav2 costmap tuning, and maintained the Python test harness used for regression runs. Worked in a shared Git repository with review-gated merges.
Built a differential-drive robot in Gazebo simulation with a ROS 2 control stack. Implemented an OpenCV lane-detection module used for the robot's guidance.
I have hands-on ROS 2 and robotics experience from a full-time associate role. I have not worked on cloud deployment.
